name: Two-Bounce Indirect Illumination
definition: Indirect illumination computation uses a two-step approach: capturing incoming radiance from light sources in octree leaves, filtering/distributing it over octree levels, and performing approximate cone tracing for light transport.
summary: Two-Bounce Indirect Illumination is a real-time GPU algorithm that captures indirect light in a sparse voxel octree to enable view-dependent specular reflections and color bleeding, unlike standard ambient occlusion.
